answer.action: Ensure compliance with revised threshold limits for derivative positions, halt rebooking of cancelled contracts, and obtain undertakings for hedging exposures.
answer.action_quote: An Authorised Dealer shall not permit users to rebook any foreign exchange derivative contract involving the INR

effective_date.quote: These Directions shall be come into force with immediate effect.
